text:
Wax (or cerumen) is a normal product of the human external ear. A dark
brownish mixture of the secretions of the ceruminous and sebaceous glands in
the outer third of the external auditory canal.
Small quantities are produced continuously and function to lubricate the canal
Quantities produced and the consistencies vary May be excessive in some
people, causing deafness, ear ache, secondary infection and even vertigo
